diagram_math_checks.objects: At fixed x in X, S=Y_x is nonempty and K=F_x. Nodes are H^q(K), H^q(S,K), H^q(S^2,K), followed by the remaining augmented row.

The F1 supplier thm-analytic-sheaf-six-operations-have-coherent-base-change-projection-and-trace steps 1.1-1.2 give proper base-change coherence; no vanishing of H^q(S,K) is asserted.

diagram_math_checks.maps: delta_-1:H^q(K)->H^q(S,K); delta_0:H^q(S,K)->H^q(S^2,K); delta_1 continues to H^q(S^3,K).
diagram_math_checks.domains_and_codomain_check: For p>=0, d_i:S^{p+2}->S^{p+1} deletes coordinate i, so d_i^* goes from H^q(S^{p+1},K) to H^q(S^{p+2},K). delta_p is sum_i (-1)^i d_i^*. delta_-1 is pullback of S->pt.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Exactly the row and differential of item step 1.2; F2 supplier lem-locally-split-cech-nerves-give-derived-cartesian-sheaf-descent step 4.1 supplies the alternating-face first-page convention.

diagram_math_checks.domains_and_codomain_check: ins_p:S^p->S^{p+1} sends (s_1,...,s_p) to (y,s_1,...,s_p); pullback reverses direction. S^0=pt gives h_0 as evaluation at y. The chosen point is only for this fixed stalk.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Item step 2.1 defines these maps. They are contraction components, not two-sided inverses of the respective delta arrows; the supporting prose explicitly distinguishes this.

relations: h_{p+1} delta_p+delta_{p-1} h_p=id on H^q(S^{p+1},K), p>=0.
diagram_math_checks.justification: For first-coordinate insertion, d_0 ins_{p+1}=id and d_i ins_{p+1}=ins_p d_{i-1} for i>0. Thus h_{p+1} delta_p has identity i=0 term and remaining sign (-1)^i, while delta_{p-1} h_p has corresponding sign (-1)^{i-1}; these cancel. For augmentation, (S->pt) composed with y:pt->S is id_pt. These are precisely item step 2.1, with no additional commutativity or acyclicity assertion.
